lines.reference: SA coconut tea biscuits label (Bakers Tennis Classic, FatSecret ZA): 1937 kJ = 463 kcal, 5.2 g protein, 21.9 g fat, 63 g carbohydrate / 100 g
Butter, salted — USDA FDC 173410: 717 kcal / 100 g
Cream substitute, powdered — USDA FDC 171263: 529 kcal / 100 g (matches SA creamer labels ~2200 kJ)
Milk, canned, condensed, sweetened — USDA FDC 171275: 321 kcal / 100 g
Lemon juice, raw — USDA FDC 167747: 22 kcal / 100 g

notes: One slice of 10. Assumptions: SA coconut tea biscuit label values; USDA powdered cream substitute values, which match SA creamer labels; all 125 ml lemon juice used; the 2 tbsp of reserved crumbs are still on the tart. The tart weighs ~1.19 kg, ~356 kcal / 100 g. No published cremora-tart figure could be found before the web search budget ran out. As a cross-check, SA chilled custard tarts run 295-369 kcal / 100 g (FatSecret ZA malva puddings and a malva milktart), and ours sits inside that band.
